$comment: Web ⇄ iOS parity record, checked by `npm run parity` (scripts/parity.mjs). Every route/enum/field difference between the two clients must appear here as `pending` (to be ported — the lagging platform's backlog) or `skip` (deliberately different, with the reason). Delete an entry once it's ported: the check fails on stale entries. Free-form ids (`ui: …`, `logic: …`) record gaps the check can't see in source. Entries marked DECODE BREAK make iOS fail to load real data and should be fixed first.

serverOnly.POST /webhooks/stripe: called by Stripe, not by a client

pending.field PlanInfo.price: DECODE BREAK: /billing/plans sends priceUsd, blurb and purchasable, not price/currency/interval, so the plan list never loads
pending.field Subscription.status: any string: DECODE BREAK: /billing/subscription sends "inactive" to every free user, and Stripe can send incomplete, unpaid or paused. Give SubscriptionStatus an init(from:) that falls back to an .unknown case
pending.field WorkoutSession.clientId: DECODE BREAK: sessions saved before client ids existed come back without one, which fails the whole /bootstrap decode
pending.field UserProfile.onboarded: DECODE BREAK: the closing profile from /ai/chat is built by the model and has no onboarded flag. Make the field optional, or give AiChatResponse its own lenient profile type
pending.GET /api/workouts: History paging. iOS only sees the /bootstrap window (see historyHasMore in CLAUDE.md)
pending.POST /api/exercises/video: YouTube demo picker: remembering the chosen video
pending.POST /auth/logout: Neither client revokes the refresh token on sign-out; both only drop it locally
pending.GET /api/ai/usage: No UI shows the daily AI allowance yet, on either platform
pending.POST /api/health/consent: Medical dashboard: the consent screen must come before any health AI call
pending.POST /api/health/chat: Medical dashboard: health chat. Show the reply's model and disclosure fields as web does
pending.logic: calorie estimates: Calories.swift uses a different MET table and duration formula from web/src/lib/calories.ts, so the same session shows a different kcal figure on each platform. Port the web logic

skip.field Program.summary: The server always sends it (rowToProgram defaults it to ""); web's type is looser than the API
skip.field Routine.favorite: The server always sends it (routines.favorite is NOT NULL)
skip.field LoggedFood.date: Swift-only local type that never crosses the API (currently unused)
skip.field LoggedFood.mealSlot: Swift-only local type that never crosses the API (currently unused)
skip.field LoggedFood.foodName: Swift-only local type that never crosses the API (currently unused)
skip.field NutritionLog.foods: Swift-only local type that never crosses the API (currently unused)
skip.ui: install prompt and update banner: PWA plumbing; the App Store handles installs and updates

pending.POST /auth/logout: Neither client revokes the refresh token on sign-out; both only drop it locally
pending.GET /api/ai/usage: No UI shows the daily AI allowance yet, on either platform

skip.ui: haptics: iOS-only (Haptics.swift); iOS Safari has no vibration API
